sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Anand Tiwari,Kuldeep Singh Chauhan
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Yadav, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri Kuldeep Singh,
learned counsel appearing for respondent no. 1 and Sri Anand Tiwari, learned counsel appearing for respondent nos. 3 and 4.
2.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a mandamus commanding respondent nos. 2 to 4 to pay fair compensation to the petitioners for acquisition of their land under the provisions of Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of user in Land) Act, 1962, read with Right Lalta Prasad And Another vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161311323/
1 to Fair Compensation and Transparency Land, Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

sentences.text: 3. Sri Anand Tiwari, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent nos. 3 and 4 has placed for our perusal the Award dated 10.03.2022 passed under the provisions of the aforesaid two Acts.
4. It is open to the petitioners to challenge the award if they feel aggrieved thereby.
No case is made out to issue any mandamus.
5. The petition stands disposed of, accordingly.
(Surendra Singh-I, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023
